metadata.name: skech
metadata.description: skech on Solana: draw ink ahead of the Bitcoin price, and the ink the price runs through pays

instructions.name: claim
docs: What the player's SKT has earned, into their balance.

accounts.name: rewards
docs: Not re-derived from its seeds (1,500 CU): only `init_rewards` makes a `Rewards`, once, at its seeds, so the
one account with its owner and discriminator is the one.

accounts.name: holder
docs: Not re-derived from its seeds either: a `Holder` is only ever made at its player's own address, so the one
that names this wallet is theirs.

accounts.name: rewards
docs: SKT's `Rewards`, or, before `init_rewards` has made it, its empty address: see `load_rewards`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of a player's `Holder` the first time a settlement mints SKT for them: whoever settles.

instructions.name: init_rewards
docs: Start SKT (`Rewards`), setting the game's terms with it. Once only, by the admin.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Set the game up: only the program's upgrade authority, who becomes its admin. `cluster` names where it runs
("devnet", "mainnet-beta", "localnet") and goes into every signed piece.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: SPL Token only: a Token-2022 mint's extensions (a transfer fee, a permanent delegate) could leave the vault
holding less than the balances, the pool and the fees it backs.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The game's associated token account. It may already exist: anyone can create another wallet's, and that
must not stop the game being set up.

instructions.name: place
docs: Place one piece. `piece` must be the first argument: its bytes are what the session key signed.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the transaction and the bet's rent, and gets the rent back when the bet is closed.

accounts.name: oracle
docs: Attests the quote by signing. Usually the payer too.

accounts.name: rewards
docs: For the holders' share of the stake fee. Written by every placement, as the pool is: no new contention.
Not re-derived from its seeds (1,500 CU): only `init_rewards` makes a `Rewards`, once, at its seeds, so the
one account with its owner and discriminator is the one.

accounts.name: bet
docs: The new bet, at seeds [BET_SEED, player, drawing, index]: created here only if the piece goes in.

accounts.name: rewards
docs: SKT's `Rewards`, or, before `init_rewards` has made it, its empty address: see `load_rewards`.

accounts.name: rent_receiver
docs: Gets back the rent of the bets closed here: only those it paid for are closed.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of a player's `Holder` the first time a settlement mints SKT for them. The oracle, usually.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Whoever sends it. If it is not the holder, they earn a cut of the growth, as on Monad.

accounts.name: caller_player
docs: The caller's own account, opened at their cost if need be, where their cut goes. Left out, they take no cut
and the holder has it all. Never the holder's: a holder redeeming their own takes no cut.

accounts.name: rewards
docs: Read for SKT's split of the fees, which the new terms must leave room for. Its owner and discriminator make
it the one `Rewards` (see `Place`).

accounts.name: rewards
docs: The one `Rewards`, by its owner and discriminator (see `Place`).

accounts.name: rewards
docs: SKT's `Rewards`, or, before `init_rewards` has made it, its empty address: see `load_rewards`.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of a player's `Holder` the first time a settlement mints SKT for them: whoever settles.

instructions.name: share_surplus
docs: What the pool holds over its reserve and what live bets could pay, to SKT holders. Anyone may.

accounts.name: from
docs: The player's own token account, on which they approved the game as delegate. Only their own tokens, into
their own balance: nothing else can be moved this way.

errors.name: BadBar
errors.msg: The bar is malformed or early

errors.name: BarConflict
errors.msg: A different bar is already posted for that second

errors.name: BarDiscontinuous
errors.msg: The bar does not follow on from the second before

errors.name: BadSettleAccounts
errors.msg: Settle accounts must come in (bet, player, holder) triples

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Only the program's upgrade authority may initialize

errors.name: BarLate
errors.msg: The bar is too late to post

errors.name: NotSplToken
errors.msg: USDC must be an SPL Token mint

errors.name: OwnRedeem
errors.msg: A holder redeeming their own takes no cut: send no caller_player

errors.name: MintScaleFixed
errors.msg: SKT's mint scale is fixed once anything has minted

errors.name: NoSurplus
errors.msg: No surplus to share: something is owed, the pool is under its reserve and what live bets could pay, there is no SKT, or SKT started too recently

types.name: AdminProposed
docs: `admin` may take over by `accept_admin`; the default key withdraws the proposal.

types.name: AdminSet
docs: `admin` has taken over.

types.name: Bar
docs: One second of the price, 8 decimals: from the second before's close to this one's high, low and close.

fields.name: second
docs: The second it is, ms since the epoch on the exchange's clock; 0 is an empty slot.

types.name: Bars
docs: The last `BAR_RING` seconds of a market's price, one slot per second. A slot is reused when its second comes
round again, and never by an older one: a second, once posted, is that bar for as long as anything can read it.

fields.name: last
docs: The latest second posted, ms.

types.name: BetSection
docs: A band of a bet as placed: `lo` to `hi` (8 decimals, on the grid), `second` seconds after it opens, staking
`stake` and paying `rung` (x100) if the price reaches it.

types.name: Claimed
docs: `player` claimed `amount` USDC e6 of what their SKT earned, into their balance.

fields.name: fee_bps
docs: Of every stake, as it is placed, to the house.

fields.name: profit_fee_bps
docs: Of every hit's profit, to the house.

fields.name: sweep_bps
docs: Of an IOU's growth, to whoever redeems it for someone else.

fields.name: late_ms
docs: How late after its opening second the oracle may have received a piece, ms.

fields.name: place_grace_ms
docs: How far from its opening second a placement may land, and how early a second may be posted, ms.

fields.name: max_price_age_ms
docs: How old the price a player saw may be when the oracle received the piece, ms.

fields.name: min_per_dot
docs: What a dot may cost, USDC e6.

fields.name: max_piece_stake
docs: The most one piece may stake, USDC e6.

fields.name: min_redeem
docs: The least a partial IOU redemption may be worth, USDC e6.

fields.name: max_session_secs
docs: How far ahead a session may be set to expire, seconds.

fields.name: swept
docs: Swept from the wallet on its standing approval, rather than sent by it.

types.name: Game
docs: The game: who runs it, what it trades in, and its terms. Its PDA owns the vault.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Set by `propose_admin`, takes over on `accept_admin`: an admin is never handed to a key that cannot sign.

fields.name: oracle
docs: Signs every placement (its quote) and every bar.

fields.name: token_program
docs: The token program the mint is under: SPL Token (`initialize` takes no other).

fields.name: vault
docs: Every player's USDC, the pool and the fees: the game PDA's associated token account.

fields.name: treasury
docs: Where collected fees go: a token account of the treasury (a multisig on mainnet).

fields.name: domain
docs: What every piece a session key signs starts with: sha256("skech/v1" || program id || cluster), so a
signature for devnet never places on mainnet, or on another deployment.

types.name: Holder
docs: A player's SKT: their shares (always staked; their SKT now is the shares over today's weight), what it has
earned, and the basis it was minted on. Keyed by their wallet; opened by the first settlement that mints for them,
so nobody who never loses costs its rent.

fields.name: shares
docs: Shares, in era `era`'s units.

fields.name: acc_at
docs: `Rewards::acc` (of era `era`) when what these shares had earned was last counted into `unclaimed`.

fields.name: unclaimed
docs: USDC e6 earned and not yet claimed.

fields.name: basis
docs: Every basis their SKT was minted on, USDC e6: the odds-weighted loss of each band of theirs that missed.

fields.name: minted
docs: Every SKT minted to them, as each mint was worth when it was minted.

types.name: HolderAccrued
docs: The holders' share of a fee (or of the pool's surplus), `amount` USDC e6, shared among `total_shares`: `acc` is
what each share has earned this era, `era`, times 1e24.

types.name: IouRateSet
docs: What is owed grows by `rate` a second from now on, x1e18.

fields.name: active
docs: Open to new pieces. Closed, its bars are still posted and its bets still settled.

fields.name: difficulty
docs: 50 to 100: how hard the game is here. Pieces placed from now on pay by it.

fields.name: name
docs: What the engine calls it: "BTC-USD".

types.name: Minted
docs: A settlement's misses minted `skt` (e6) to `player`, as `shares` at today's weight, on `basis` (USDC e6): `rate` SKT
per dollar of basis, x1e6. `capped`: SKT the curve gave that the wallet's cap kept from minting.

types.name: Owed
docs: `to` is owed `value` as IOU shares; the house when `to` is the default key.

types.name: PieceMessage
docs: What a player's session key signs: a piece of a drawing, bet as it is drawn.

fields.name: domain
docs: `Game.domain`: this deployment on this cluster.

fields.name: player
docs: The player's wallet.

fields.name: drawing
docs: The drawing this piece is part of, and its number within it: together they name the bet.

fields.name: difficulty
docs: The difficulty the player was shown. If the market's has changed since, the piece is refused.

fields.name: open_at
docs: The second it opens on, ms. Its bands are 1 to 30 seconds after it.

fields.name: per_dot
docs: What one dot costs, USDC e6.

fields.name: unit
docs: The price grid the bands sit on, 8 decimals: bands are judged one unit wider each way.

fields.name: price_seen
docs: The price on the player's screen when they drew, and its time, as the engine signed it (checked by the oracle).

fields.name: stroke_hash
docs: sha256 of the stroke's points. The stroke itself stays with the relayer: it is too big for a transaction.

types.name: Placed
docs: A piece went in. `refunded` is the stake of bands not offered, which never left the balance.

types.name: Player
docs: A player: their balance in the game, their session and what they are owed. Keyed by their wallet.

fields.name: balance
docs: USDC e6, theirs to play with or take out.

fields.name: iou_shares
docs: IOU shares they hold, and what they were owed when those were issued.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who paid this account's rent; it goes back to them if the account is ever closed.

types.name: Pool
docs: The money that is not anyone's balance: what backs live stakes and pays hits, and the house's fees.

fields.name: pool
docs: USDC backing live stakes and paying hits, e6.

fields.name: fees
docs: Fees taken and not yet collected, e6.

fields.name: iou_index_at
docs: An IOU share's value at `iou_time_at`, x1e18, rising by `iou_rate` every second.

fields.name: iou_shares
docs: Every share outstanding, the house's included.

fields.name: house_shares
docs: What the house was owed in fees the pool could not pay at once. No longer added to: the house's cut is taken
only from what the pool has left. Kept, for what an earlier version issued, and for the account's layout.

types.name: QuoteArgs
docs: What the oracle attests about a piece, by signing the transaction that carries it: the market on its opening
second and each band's chance, measured off chain on thousands of real price paths.

fields.name: price
docs: The price the second before `open_at` closed at, 8 decimals.

fields.name: momentum
docs: The last three seconds' move in volatilities, x1e6.

fields.name: received_at
docs: When the oracle received the piece, ms.

fields.name: chances
docs: Each band's chance, in billionths, in the piece's order.

types.name: Rewards
docs: SKT's global state: the shares, the holders' accumulator and the USDC set aside for them, the tracked gain the mint
curve reads, the decay's clock, and what live bets could pay. Every SKT stays staked on the `Holder` it was minted to:
there is no token to move.

fields.name: supply
docs: SKT minted, ever, as each mint was worth when it was minted (millionths): the record, not what is held now.

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Every holder's shares, in this era's units: each SKT minted at time t adds 2^((t − era start) / half-life).

fields.name: acc
docs: USDC e6 each share has earned this era, times `ACC_SCALE`. Back to 0 at each era's start.

fields.name: holder_funds
docs: USDC e6 in the vault that is the holders': accrued and not yet claimed, the accumulator's rounding dust with it.

fields.name: accrued_total
docs: Every holder share ever accrued, and every claim paid out: `holder_funds` is the one less the other.

fields.name: gain
docs: The tracked gain, USDC e6: every basis SKT has been minted on since it began, which is what players have lost
to the game in expectation. The mint curve reads it.

fields.name: era
docs: The era: shares and `acc` are in its units.

fields.name: era_ends
docs: `acc` at the end of each of the last ERAS_KEPT eras, at era % ERAS_KEPT.

fields.name: anchor_log2
docs: A share's weight at `anchor_time`, as its log2 times 2^32: under ERA_HALVINGS · 2^32 once caught up.

fields.name: liability
docs: The most every live bet placed since SKT started could pay, gross, every band hitting: what the pool keeps,
with the reserve, before any surplus is shared.

fields.name: swept_total
docs: Pool surplus shared with holders, ever.

fields.name: started_at
docs: When SKT started: no surplus is shared until every bet placed before then, whose liability is not counted, is
decided or given back.

fields.name: _reserved
docs: Room for what comes later, without a realloc.

types.name: RewardsConfig
docs: SKT's terms, set beside `Config`: `Config` lives in `Game`, whose layout stays as it is on chain.

fields.name: holder_fee_bps
docs: Of every stake, to SKT holders: part of `Config::fee_bps`, never more.

fields.name: holder_profit_fee_bps
docs: Of every hit's profit, to SKT holders: part of `Config::profit_fee_bps`, never more.

fields.name: mint_scale
docs: `S` in the mint curve, USDC e6: at tracked gain G a dollar of basis mints 100 · (S / (S + G))² SKT. Fixed once
anything has minted.

fields.name: half_life_secs
docs: SKT's half-life, seconds: a balance halves every this long, so a player keeps their share only by playing on.

fields.name: wallet_cap_bps
docs: No mint takes a wallet past this share of all shares, bps (10,000: no cap)…

fields.name: cap_floor
docs: …or past that share of this much SKT (e6), whichever is more: so the first players mint while there is little.

fields.name: surplus_reserve
docs: USDC e6 the pool keeps, over what every live bet could pay, before any of its surplus is shared with holders.

fields.name: surplus_holder_bps
docs: Of the pool's surplus, to SKT holders, bps; the rest to the treasury.

types.name: SectionArg
docs: A band, as signed: `lo` and `hi` are counted in grid units (so they sit on the grid by construction), `stake` in
USDC e6. 11 bytes.

fields.name: second
docs: Seconds after the piece opens, 1 to 30.

fields.name: lo
docs: The band's bottom, in units of `unit` from zero.

fields.name: width
docs: Its height, in units.

types.name: Session
docs: A player's session key: an Ed25519 key their app keeps, which may place pieces for them, up to an allowance,
until it expires. It can never withdraw.

fields.name: valid_until
docs: Unix seconds, by the chain's clock.

fields.name: allowance
docs: USDC e6 the session may still stake.

types.name: Settled
docs: Bands decided: `paid` USDC into the balance, `owed` as IOU.

fields.name: closed
docs: Every band decided: the bet is closed.

fields.name: expired_mask
docs: Bands whose second can no longer be posted, given back by `expire`, and what they gave back (in `paid` and
`owed` with the rest).

types.name: SurplusShared
docs: What the pool held over the reserve and what every live bet could pay: `amount` USDC e6 shared with holders,
`treasury` to the treasury (its 25% and the cap floor's part of the holders'); `kept` stays in the pool.
